question: Learning License Apply (1) - online apply kaise kare 2026 me?
q: Learning License Apply (1) - online apply kaise kare 2026 me?
q_en: How to complete Learning License Apply (Case 1) via official Parivahan portal in 2026?
answer:
Sarkari Seva Overview & Guidance 2026

Official portal sarathi.parivahan.gov.in par Learning License Apply ke liye aavedan karne ki prakriya behad saral aur digital hai. Sabse pehle Portal par jaye, apna State aur RTO branch select kare. Zaroori documents jaise Aadhaar card, Purani RC/DL, aur address proof upload kare. Aadhaar eKYC se contactless verification complete kare. Online fee payment gateway ke dwara charges pay kare aur acknowledgement receipt download kare. Status track karne ke liye Application Number ka upayog kare. Source: sarathi.parivahan.gov.in

Aavedan Prakriya - Step by Step Process

  • Official portal https://sarathi.parivahan.gov.in par visit kare.
  • Apna Mobile Number aur OTP dalkar authentication complete kare.
  • Form me zaroori jankari jaise Name, Address, Aadhaar Details, Bank Passbook bhare.
  • Scanned copies of required documents upload kare aur eKYC verify kare.
  • NetBanking / UPI / SBI ePay se prescribe fees pay kare aur acknowledgement slip save kare.

Zaroori Documents List (Required Proofs)

  • Aadhaar Card (Mobile Number Linked)
  • Voter ID Card / Domicile Certificate / Address Proof
  • Income Certificate & Bank Passbook Copy
  • Recent Passport Size Photograph

Helpline & Official Source

Kuch bhi samasya hone par official portal https://sarathi.parivahan.gov.in par Grievance section check kare ya Toll-Free Number 1800-11-0001 par call kare. Source: https://sarathi.parivahan.gov.in

Government Service Overview & Guidance 2026

Applying for Learning License Apply on the official portal sarathi.parivahan.gov.in is streamlined and fully digital in 2026. Visit the portal, select your State and RTO center, fill in the application form, and complete Aadhaar eKYC verification. Step by Step Application Process

  • Visit the official portal https://sarathi.parivahan.gov.in.
  • Authenticate using your registered Mobile Number and OTP.
  • Fill in required personal, identity, and bank account details accurately.
  • Upload scanned supporting documents and complete eKYC verification.
  • Pay the prescribed fees via online payment gateway and download the acknowledgment receipt.

List of Required Documents

  • Aadhaar Card (with linked mobile number)
  • Voter ID / Residence Proof / Ration Card
  • Income Certificate & Active Bank Account Details
  • Passport size photograph

q_en: How to complete DL Status Check via Application No (Case 8) via official Parivahan portal in 2026?
answer:
Sarkari Seva Overview & Guidance 2026

Official portal sarathi.parivahan.gov.in par DL Status Check via Application No ke liye aavedan karne ki prakriya behad saral aur digital hai. Sabse pehle Portal par jaye, apna State aur RTO branch select kare. Zaroori documents jaise Aadhaar card, Purani RC/DL, aur address proof upload kare. Aadhaar eKYC se contactless verification complete kare. Online fee payment gateway ke dwara charges pay kare aur acknowledgement receipt download kare. Status track karne ke liye Application Number ka upayog kare. Source: sarathi.parivahan.gov.in

Aavedan Prakriya - Step by Step Process

  • Official portal https://sarathi.parivahan.gov.in par visit kare.
  • Apna Mobile Number aur OTP dalkar authentication complete kare.
  • Form me zaroori jankari jaise Name, Address, Aadhaar Details, Bank Passbook bhare.
  • Scanned copies of required documents upload kare aur eKYC verify kare.
  • NetBanking / UPI / SBI ePay se prescribe fees pay kare aur acknowledgement slip save kare.

Zaroori Documents List (Required Proofs)

  • Aadhaar Card (Mobile Number Linked)
  • Voter ID Card / Domicile Certificate / Address Proof
  • Income Certificate & Bank Passbook Copy
  • Recent Passport Size Photograph

Helpline & Official Source

Kuch bhi samasya hone par official portal https://sarathi.parivahan.gov.in par Grievance section check kare ya Toll-Free Number 1800-11-0001 par call kare. Source: https://sarathi.parivahan.gov.in
